items.q: Well, Jonah Jones told me that they all thought that anything from Chicago was Western in New York.

ctx.x: Well, Jonah Jones told me that they all thought that anything from Chicago was Western in New York.

But you must remember that it was Blues-oriented, the ones from the West. When you came to New York, you had the atmosphere of Broadway, Show Business, Pop Music, Tin Pan Alley, and you had ethnical...the ethnic groups or other groups were much more together, much more mixed than they were outside of New York. You know what I mean?
